criteria.criterion_exact: Record a source/artifact-bound, value-free inventory separating player username/password/token, developer API identity, and previously retained device settings.
Trace existing Nova sign-in to earlier evidence or explicitly retain unknown origin; never infer a clean image from a successful state-preserving upgrade.
Verify a clean image starts with no personal player account and retained-storage upgrades keep the selected user's account, using disposable VM evidence and unchanged-settings receipts.

Verify public release preflight refuses personal build/runtime credentials; synthetic positive/negative fixtures exercise the guard and final accepted payload is checked. Repair any confirmed leak before publication.
Bind displayed backup/restore dates to their actual local stamp fields and status; distinguish attempted, completed-empty and data-transferring operations using retained logs where available.
Trace the two Recent entries to metadata fields and available setup/copy/restore records; state any remaining unknown origin explicitly.
Inspect exact firmware/default payloads and clean-boot storage for cloud activity stamps, play-history metadata, connection state and QA residue; publish only value-free results.
Exercise the isolation gate with synthetic contaminated and clean payloads; fresh installation has no fabricated activity while upgrade preserves legitimate existing history.

Record source-bound metadata paths and operational-script scope, distinguishing imported library history from firmware-seeded or retained account state. Evidence: accepted source paths above and docs/qa-logs/2026-10-13-nova-library-copy.md.

Include a synthetic library-copy case in #565 VM qualification: ROM-only versus ROM-plus-gamelist.xml, expected Recent behavior, and unchanged account/activity-stamp state. Retain source-bound fixture results.

Record the owner-selected interim JELOS developer identity and separate replacement work into #586 (D-WORKFLOW-166). This records the project decision, not new provider authorization or completed provisioning.

Implement and document the selected interim developer provisioning route and applicable artifact checks; reconcile current runtime-only comments and historical guard descriptions under D-WORKFLOW-166. Preserve unrelated private-credential protections; prove actual checks execute.
Implement approved release provisioning without requiring ordinary players to enter developer credentials; keep their own account login distinct and preserve working runtime fallback as appropriate.
Review English/French accounts/options/error flows at small/large sizes, update canonical IA/menu/flow references and source-bound frames, and verify clean/upgrade plus credential backup exclusions.
Inventory exact entry-row/help/confirmation/progress text in the accepted ES pin and its flow/frame reference; establish whether the advance-explanation gap still exists.

If needed, revise existing copy to explain that newly added games will be prepared for offline achievements when that feature is enabled, matching actual indexing/connectivity gates without implying every library update redownloads everything.
Verify disabled/enabled, online/offline, and new/no-new game branches with source-bound VM receipts; preserve behavior and responsiveness.

Update English/French strings, canonical menu/IA/flow reference and reviewed 640x480/1280x800 frames in the same change. If current copy already meets the request, close with exact-source reviewed-frame evidence instead.
